About
Incorporated in 1994, Fusion Finance
Ltd is primarily engaged in microfinance
lending activities
[1]
Key Points
Business Verticals
a) MFI Business:
[1]
The company primarily offers group-based microfinance loans to women through Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of
5-7
members, where repayments are backed by mutual guarantees. Loans are offered for
17-25
months at interest rates of
23.4%-23.98%
(reducing balance), with repayments every
14 or 28
days.
